description:
A coaster hachita…so classic it hurts.

Size Medium…let me know if you need somethig different.

I built up this bike for myself to ride on the Weedsac. 140 miles of New Mexico riding in the sacramento mountains was the perfect shakedown… this thing is perfect. Pick it up at a deep discount…let me know if you’d like the dust washed off or not.

Handbuilt 27.5 coaster wheelset. Janpanese Sansin 40h front hub laced radially to classic polished Velocity Atlas hoops. Our souped up shimano coaster with all the options. A super nice wheelset…perfect for your mountain coaster teurer.

Quill converted with a riser nitto stem, soma portola bars and campandgoslow rattler tape. Speaking of rattler…that bottle cage is included too…try and find another one.

Vintage brooks and 2.4 Maxxis Minions…hot combo, rough and rando. Thomson post, classic shimano 600 cranks, MKS gordito pedals, stainless VO rack. Its the perfect mix and classic and capable.

Priced as a used bike…with only 140 miles. You pay less and get more character and piece of mind that this baby is dialed.
